headline: Shrimp farming and its strategy for new markets
summary: Growing market positioning of Ecuadorian shrimp is forcing Sonora farms to develop new collection and cooling strategies as the market shifts.
why: Shrimp is a major aquaculture export for Mexico, and competition from Ecuador, the largest global exporter, affects farm pricing and export access.
original_headline: La camaronicultura y su estrategia ante los nuevos mercados
